summary: A residents' survey gives a trustee a reason to seek one dependable address for temporary service.
realLife: Friends of the South End Library reported that their survey favored a consistent place for service and that a working group had considered the former settlement-house headquarters.
inGame: needs: survey findings and candidate site.

turns.pulledBy: One site offers a recurring booking.
turns.what: The group checks whether the proposed hours fit the survey responses.
turns.writesBack: The recommendation names a site and its available hours.

turns.what: The group lays the dates beside the survey request.
turns.writesBack: Trustees receive the list of weeks with no dependable location.
